title: Coupang “~90% off”: what the steepest verifiable deals actually are
audience: A careful shopper who hates fake sale badges
governingThought: Coupang’s headline “up to 90% off” is marketing shorthand — verified company press releases and sale guides cap most major events at 70–80%, with item-level math that shoppers can check before checkout.
takeaways: Official Coupang sale pages ([Wow Big Sale](https://news.coupang.com/archives/54613/), [Kupase fashion sale](https://zdnet.co.kr/view/?no=20250619143645)) advertise **maximum 70–80%** off — not a standing 90% floor on clothing.

Steepest **item-level** examples from press coverage: Adidas Samba OG at **~64–70% off** (~₩90,000 band), New Balance tees at **~2만원대**, Gap slippers at **~₩8,000** during Kupase ([Seoul Times](https://www.seoultimes.news/news/article.html?no=2000074264)).

Treat any “90%+” badge as unverified until you compare **listed price vs. your own price-history screenshot** — Coupang’s own [sale guide](https://guide.coupang.com/all-about-coupang-fashion-sale-2025/) documents 80% as the Kupase ceiling.

blocks.text: Coupang runs several named sale events. In 2025, the company’s own newsroom described [Wow Big Sale](https://news.coupang.com/archives/54613/) as **up to 70% off** across 14 categories (July 7–13, 2025). [Wow Week](https://news.coupang.com/archives/55610/) (Aug 18–24, 2025) also capped at **70%**. Fashion-specific [Kupase (쿠패세)](https://zdnet.co.kr/view/?no=20250619143645) ran June 16–29, 2025 with **up to 80%** on 500+ brands.

blocks.title: No verified 90% platform-wide sale found
blocks.text: Across Coupang newsroom releases and Korean press recaps searched for this brief, **80%** is the highest event ceiling cited for fashion (Kupase). Individual SKUs may show higher percentage badges in-app, but those require per-item verification — see Section 3.

A July 2026 [Women’s Fashion Festival](https://www.ajupress.com/view/20260709091270107) (through July 12) offered tiered coupons (₩5,000 off ₩50,000+; ₩15,000 off ₩100,000+) rather than a flat 90% headline.

sections.title: Verified steepest categories and example products

blocks.text: These examples come from Coupang’s Kupase press coverage — prices are **approximate bands** as reported by media, not live checkout quotes. Open Coupang search for the product name to see today’s price.

**Useful non-clothing:** [Cougase (가전·디지털 세일)](https://news.coupang.com/archives/57782/) (Oct 27–Nov 9, 2025 press window) featured **₩100** and **₩9,900** flash SKUs plus up to 20% card discounts — verify availability in the Coupang app’s “선착순 특가” corner.

Product search entry points (prices change daily): search Coupang for [“아디다스 삼바 OG”](https://www.coupang.com/np/search?q=%EC%95%84%EB%94%94%EB%8B%A4%EC%8A%A4+%EC%82%BC%EB%B0%94+OG), [“뉴발란스 저지 티셔츠”](https://www.coupang.com/np/search?q=%EB%89%B4%EB%B0%9C%EB%9E%80%EC%8A%A4+%EC%A0%80%EC%A7%80), [“갭 슬리퍼”](https://www.coupang.com/np/search?q=%EA%B0%AD+%EC%8A%AC%EB%A6%AC%ED%8D%BC).

items: **Cross-check the percentage** — if the badge says 90% but Coupang’s own event page caps at 80%, screenshot both.
**Compare outside Coupang** — check the brand’s official store or [Naver Shopping](https://shopping.naver.com/) price history for the same SKU.
**Watch coupon stacking** — Wow-member coupons (₩5,000 off ₩50,000+) change the paid price but not always the displayed “% off” badge.
**Rocket Wow vs non-member** — instant discounts in [Kupase guide](https://guide.coupang.com/all-about-coupang-fashion-sale-2025/) are member-specific; the badge may assume Wow pricing.
